prompt:
SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: a tiny GNAT dart — a needle-nosed minnow drone with swept finlets and a glowing stinger at its snout, teal-aqua body. The palette: teal-aqua stone #336a64 #2a5a58, lit aqua #5a9aa0 #7fe8d0 #c8ecdc with pale #d8fff4 highlights, near-black navy outline — the AZURE VERGE zone.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 2 equal square cells laid out as TWO cells in ONE row of TWO (2 columns by 1 row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom): the SAME subject, lying HORIZONTALLY (wider than tall, about 1.3:1), centred in its cell at the same scale — ONLY the named state changes between cells; the silhouette stays identical in all cells.
  cell 1 = winding up: stinger DIM; cell 2 = charging: stinger BLAZING white-aqua.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 40 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge (outline only around the bright core, fading out in the halo), no anti-aliasing, no motion blur.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell
label: GEN4 owner-waived never-designed slot enemies/azure-gnat 2f sheet 512x256
